description: Feed a native agent result back into the gossipcat relay. Call this after a Claude Code Agent() completes a task dispatched via gossip_dispatch or gossip_run. Enables consensus cross-review and gossip for native agents.

agent_started_at.description: Timestamp (ms) when Agent() was launched. Used to measure actual agent execution time vs dispatch overhead.

error.description: Error message if the agent failed

relay_token.description: One-time token issued at dispatch time. Required for native agent relays — prevents task-ID spoofing.

task_id.description: Task ID returned by gossip_dispatch or gossip_run

name: gossip_relay
